summary: 100 ft Aermotor with a parallel staircase in Tippah County, MS; NHLR-registered July 2022 as US 1684. Register says the MFC no longer uses the site. No build date found.

facts.design: 100-foot Aermotor with a parallel staircase; 14 landings and 15 flights, bottom flights missing when registered
facts.status_note: Described from a July 2022 NHLR site visit; no later report found

access.note: The register does not say who owns the site now or whether visitors may enter.

facts.agency: Mississippi Forestry Commission (the register's 'Administered by' field; the same listing says the site is no longer used by the MFC)

notes_for_editor: Only the NHLR detail page supplies tower facts. Two searches and a topo page (anyplaceamerica.com, HTTP 403) added nothing about this tower. The register lists the MFC as administering the site but also says the MFC no longer uses it; the owner today is unknown, so access is 'unknown' rather than guessed. Current status rests on the July 2022 site visit. The 'missing bottom flights' note is the register writer's, from 2022. The Aermotor page is context only and does not identify this tower's model.
